title: Drinks
statementMd:
Little Vasya loves orange juice very much. That's why any food and drink in his kitchen necessarily contains orange juice. There are $*n*$ drinks in his fridge, the volume fraction of orange juice in the $*i*$-th drink equals $*p*_{*i*}$ percent.

One day Vasya decided to make himself an orange cocktail. He took equal proportions of each of the $*n*$ drinks and mixed them. Then he wondered, how much orange juice the cocktail has.

Find the volume fraction of orange juice in the final drink.

## Input

The first input line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of orange-containing drinks in Vasya's fridge. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*p*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 100$) — the volume fraction of orange juice in the $*i*$-th drink, in percent. The numbers are separated by a space.

## Output

Print the volume fraction in percent of orange juice in Vasya's cocktail. The answer will be considered correct if the absolute or relative error does not exceed $10 ^{ - 4}$.

## Note

Note to the first sample: let's assume that Vasya takes $*x*$ milliliters of each drink from the fridge. Then the volume of pure juice in the cocktail will equal ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c1fac6e64d3a8ee6a5ac138cbe51e60039b22473.png) milliliters. The total cocktail's volume equals $3·*x*$ milliliters, so the volume fraction of the juice in the cocktail equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ceb0664e55a1f9f5fa1243ec74680a4665a4d58d.png), that is, $66.(6)$ percent.
statementZhMd:
小 Vasya 非常喜欢橙汁。因此，他厨房里的任何食物和饮料都必然含有橙汁。他的冰箱里有 $*n*$ 种饮料，第 $*i*$ 种饮料中橙汁的体积分数为 $*p*_{*i*}$%。

一天，Vasya 决定给自己调制一杯橙汁鸡尾酒。他取出每种饮料等量的部分并将它们混合。然后他想知道，这杯鸡尾酒中含有多少橙汁。

请你求出最终饮料中橙汁的体积分数。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——Vasya 冰箱中含橙汁的饮料数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*p*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）——第 $*i*$ 种饮料中橙汁的体积分数，单位为百分比。数字之间用空格分隔。

## 输出格式

输出 Vasya 的鸡尾酒中橙汁的体积分数，单位为百分比。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10 ^{ - 4}$，则视为正确。

## 说明

第一个样例说明：假设 Vasya 从冰箱中每种饮料取出 $*x*$ 毫升。那么鸡尾酒中纯橙汁的体积将等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c1fac6e64d3a8ee6a5ac138cbe51e60039b22473.png) 毫升。鸡尾酒的总体积为 $3·*x*$ 毫升，因此鸡尾酒中橙汁的体积分数为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ceb0664e55a1f9f5fa1243ec74680a4665a4d58d.png)，即 $66.(6)$%。
